answer: Histories are stored in pearl, checked in bridge, and trellis shows each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 13 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2666 identities would post 681 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
